To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) PMUs provide a valuable tool to monitor, control and optimize the operation of the distribution grid; (2) PMU data can be utilized for the control of the distribution network in a variety of applications; (3) PMU data could help the distribution system operator (DSO) in making better decisions and improving system operation; and (4) PMU data is a key element for the development of a smart grid.
PMUs can be used to enhance DMS functions, such as: state estimation and fault detection, and can be used to improve the performance of the distribution grid.

the use of PMUs in the distribution grid is a necessity for the distribution grid to be able to handle the increasing number of DERs and active loads, which will change the traditional grid to a faster-changing multi-source network.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) the necessity of PMUs for the distribution grid, (2) the potential applications for the distribution grid that can benefit from phasor measurements, (3) the challenges in applying PMUs in the distribution grid, and (4) a proposed framework for PMU application in the distribution grid.
developing new control and protection algorithms for the distribution grid that can benefit from the new PMU data.

the use of PMU data within the DMS is necessary to achieve the optimal operation of the distribution grid with high penetration of DER.

the benefits of PMU data in the distribution grid are more than the mere improvement of state estimation and fault detection.
